rationale.idea: A clean confirmation ablation removes only checkpoint combination from the current best single-run recipe.
rationale.why_expected_to_help: Top-N checkpoints from one run are highly correlated and, if valid peaks early then declines, averaging them can dilute the best epoch rather than add independent signal; using a single checkpoint also removes one source of same-validation selection complexity before the final recipe is trusted.
rationale.grounded_in: This directly tests the current incumbent from node 1 (0.60343 with n_checkpoints=3, checkpoint_combine=true) against the menu-controlled ablation chosen by the search policy. It is specifically grounded in the recorded dead-end note: 'Snapshot/checkpoint ensembling ... rejected by its own guard. Valid peaks at epoch 4 then declines monotonically, so the top-N checkpoints are one peak plus strictly worse neighbours from the same trajectory -- averaging DILUTES.' The methodology warning also applies: 'a score computed on the same data that selected it is not evidence of generalisation.'
